notes.title: Full Release Version 1.0
notes.content:
Full Release Version 1.0 includes:

[list]
[*] Hire Cashiers, up to 4 cashiers in store
[*] Hire Restockers, up to 2 restockers in store
[*] Buy Checkout tills and move them around the store
[*] New products, specially new things to decorate your store
[*] Disassemble full displays and move them with all the merchandise instead of creating more boxes
[*] More clients each day and better balance on the products they choose to buy
[*] Ability to add a display tag to your Vinyl or CDs furniture so you can arrange them by genre as an example
[*] Throw boxes into the trash bins even if they are open (no more closing them in order to dispose of a box)
[*] Better system to put posters on walls (more posters are available as well)
[*] Customers have speech bubbles to know products they want or to give some clues about their satisfaction rating
[*] Refreshed HUD and optimized visuals
[*] Fixed bugs with store upgrades
[*] Fixed bugs with customer paths around furniture
[*] Better balance for unlocking things and income over time
[*] Tons of general bug fixes and optimizations
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.9.0 (Christmas and CDs Update)
notes.content:
-Added new product (CDs) to the collection
-Added 5 CD record labels
-Added CD Stand furniture
-Added Christmas decorations
-Office computer UI fixes
-Reduced garbage spawn chances
-General bug fixes

notes.title: Update 0.8.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed purchases of some items going to the "short change" section
[*]Fixed some furniture obstacle navigation
[*]Fixed bug related to scanning products multiple times
[*]Fixed bug related to customer going back to idle and not showing payment method
[*]Full support for numerical keys and keypad keys for the credit card transactions
[*]Sellable furniture (get close to the furniture you want to sell and can be sold for 50% of the original cost)
[*]Exit computers by just walking instead of pressing 'Escape' key
[*]Faster run speed (pressing left shift)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.8.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed colors of records and headphones stands that were not being saved (this may require to repurchase the furniture, sellable furniture is coming in the next patch)
[*]Fixed items being duplicated or scanned multiple times in the checkout.
[*]Fixed distance of the camera when using credit card
[*]Fixed pathfinding and obstacle boxes for some stands that were causing issues
[*]Changed walking and running speed to be consistent with different specs
[/list]

notes.title: Big Update 0.8.1
notes.content:
Thank you for patiently waiting for the game update, we appreciate all the feedback, here is a list with some of the changes made for version 0.8.1, this includes the same fixes as 0.8.0 but with a crash patch:

[list]
[*]Added Credit Card payment method
[*]Added Cleaning Robot (Broombot) that can be acquired in the store
[*]Added Trash can in the mall area
[*]Added counter for records already purchased on each section of the store
[*]Revamped the UI
[*]Updated prices panel can be shown or hidden at any point
[*]Added Halloween decoration
[*]Streamlined the purchase process of each client
[*]Fixed bugs with clients
[*]Fixed bugs related to payment methods
[*]Fixes to lighting and geometry
[*]Fixes to Box colliders and physics
[*]General bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.6.5 (UltraWide screen support)
notes.content:
We have updated the game to version 0.6.5, this version has the following changes/fixes:

[list]
[*]UltraWide monitor support
[*]Fixed bugs regarding record label purchases
[*]Removed music as an upgrade and is available from the start, can be accessed through the tools menu

[/list]
